payload.title: Spike: language group fields and index through the real publish path
payload.description: In a sandbox backend: add language and languageGroupId to Item with a languageGroupId+language index, create one Spanish localization lineage beside its English primary, publish both through publish_item and the projection, and measure invalidation paths per publish against maxInvalidationPaths. Confirm per-lineage approvals keyed by content hash keep the languages separate. Plan: docs/plans/multilingual-publishing.md (PR #1450).
